scripts.dev: concurrently --names "backend,frontend" --prefix-colors "cyan,magenta" "bun run --cwd apps/backend dev" "bun run --cwd apps/frontend dev"
scripts.docker:up: docker compose --env-file .env.docker down --remove-orphans && docker compose --env-file .env.docker up --build
scripts.docker:up:d: docker compose --env-file .env.docker down --remove-orphans && docker compose --env-file .env.docker up --build -d
scripts.docker:up:dev: docker compose --env-file .env.docker down --remove-orphans && docker compose --env-file .env.docker -f docker-compose.yml -f docker-compose.override.yml up --build
scripts.docker:up:dev:d: docker compose --env-file .env.docker down --remove-orphans && docker compose --env-file .env.docker -f docker-compose.yml -f docker-compose.override.yml up --build -d
scripts.docker:up:monitoring: docker compose --env-file .env.docker down --remove-orphans && docker compose --env-file .env.docker -f docker-compose.yml -f docker-compose.monitoring.yml up --build
scripts.docker:up:monitoring:d: docker compose --env-file .env.docker down --remove-orphans && docker compose --env-file .env.docker -f docker-compose.yml -f docker-compose.monitoring.yml up --build -d
